articles.title: Reuters: Hong Kong vies to win over resource-rich Central Asia
articles.summary: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee tours Central Asia to boost economic ties and secure resource partnerships.
articles.content: Reuters reports that Hong Kong is actively seeking to strengthen its influence in Central Asia. Chief Executive John Lee is currently touring the region to negotiate trade agreements and resource-sharing partnerships, aiming to diversify Hong Kong's economic dependencies.

articles.title: BBC News: Hong Kong and Beijing maintain high security levels
articles.summary: Continued high security presence in Hong Kong and Beijing following the recent June anniversary events.
articles.content: BBC News highlights the ongoing stringent security measures in major cities. In Hong Kong, police presence remains visible in key areas to prevent unauthorized gatherings and maintain public order following a sensitive anniversary week.

articles.title: 追新聞：北極地緣政治升溫，香港角色受關注
articles.summary: 隨著北極航道開放，分析指香港作為航運樞紐可能在「冰上絲綢之路」中扮演物流角色。
articles.content: 《追新聞》分析指出，中美在北極的博弈日益激烈。隨著全球暖化導致航道開放，香港的物流與法律專業服務或可為相關貿易提供支援。然而，地緣政治風險仍是投資者的首要考量。

articles.title: 集誌社：香港新媒體環境的挑戰與轉型
articles.summary: 探討在現行環境下，香港獨立媒體如何透過數位化與訂閱制尋求生存空間。
articles.content: 集誌社專題報導香港媒體轉型現狀。在傳統廣告收入萎縮與環境變遷下，許多小型媒體轉向 Patreon 或訂閱制。報導訪談了多名資深傳媒人，分享如何在壓力下維持報導專業性。

articles.title: SCMP: Legislative Council discusses new economic stimulus measures
articles.summary: Hong Kong lawmakers propose tax breaks and grants to boost the post-pandemic retail and tourism sectors.
articles.content: As reported by major local outlets, the Legislative Council is debating a new stimulus package. Proposals include vouchers for residents and grants for small businesses in the tourism sector to attract international visitors.

articles.title: The Verge: The Next Decade of AI Computing
articles.summary: Special report on how quantum computing and AI are converging to reshape the tech landscape by 2030.
articles.content: The Verge explores the intersection of quantum leap and neural networks. Industry leaders predict a shift in how we perceive intelligence as hardware catches up to algorithm demands.

articles.title: Wired: Major Security Flaw Discovered in Global Infrastructure
articles.summary: Cybersecurity experts warn of a critical vulnerability affecting cloud services used by major financial institutions.
articles.content: A collective of security researchers has identified a 'zero-day' exploit that could compromise encrypted communications globally. Wired investigates the race to patch the systems before exploitation.

articles.title: Reuters: Oil Prices Stabilize Amid Arctic Trade Talks
articles.summary: Markets react positively as nations discuss sustainable resource extraction in the emerging Arctic corridors.
articles.content: Brent crude settled higher today as diplomatic efforts in Helsinki showed promise. Reuters sources confirm that a framework for Arctic environmental protection is being drafted, easing supply chain anxiety.

articles.title: 棱角媒體：海外港人社群調查，身分認同持續強化
articles.summary: 最新研究顯示，移居海外的港人對「香港人」身分認同不降反升，積極參與本地文化傳承活動。
articles.content: 《棱角媒體》報導一份針對英、加、澳三地港人的調查。結果顯示，逾九成受訪者表示會在家中堅持使用廣東話，並希望下一代能了解香港歷史。這反映出海外港人正透過文化軟實力建立獨特的離散社群。

articles.title: Unwire: 傳 Apple 2026 年底推出全新摺疊式 iPad
articles.summary: 供應鏈消息指出，Apple 正加快研發大螢幕摺疊裝置，預計將取代現有的 iPad Pro 系列。
articles.content: 根據 Unwire 引述韓國科技媒體報導，Apple 的摺疊螢幕專利已進入試產階段。這款裝置可能擁有 20 吋的展開螢幕，並配備全新的視窗管理系統，旨在重新定義行動辦公。
